title: MatFormer FFN granularity and Mirror neuron roles
hypothesis: Granularity-specific Mirror neuron role codes recover width-specific FFN functions from shared nested neurons with fewer bytes than independent widths and better storage than ordinary gains.

development.selection_metric: per-width nMSE, distinct outputs, actual serialized bytes

fresh.reason: Direct ordinary gain is an exact function-class and payload control.

storage.authority: actual deterministic NPZ inference payload bytes

success_gate: All widths nMSE <=1e-6; >=20% fewer bytes than independent widths; >=10% fewer bytes than direct gains.
failure_gate: Direct gains match Mirror, or plain nested prefix already meets quality.
boundaries: no MatFormer training or language-model claim
